BrochureContent.Content:
Glenogue Ballyfad (approx. 159 sqm) is a beautifully presented three-bedroom detached bungalow set on a generous site of approximately 0.88 acres, enjoying breath-taking panoramic sea views across the Wicklow and Wexford coastline. This attractive home offers a rare combination of countryside tranquillity, spacious accommodation, and convenient access to nearby towns and villages.
The property is finished in an elegant and tasteful style throughout, with bright, well-proportioned rooms and excellent storage. A welcoming entrance hall leads to a spacious living room featuring solid herringbone wooden flooring and a striking marble fireplace with open fire. The large kitchen/dining room is fitted with a quality kitchen and Rangemaster gas hob with electric oven, while an adjoining utility room provides additional storage, fitted units, and direct access to the garden.
The accommodation comprises three generously sized bedrooms, including a master bedroom with built-in wardrobe and en-suite. Two further double bedrooms also benefit from built-in wardrobes, while the family bathroom is fully tiled and fitted with a jacuzzi bath and a power shower.
Occupying an elevated position, the property enjoys exceptional coastal views and a wonderful sense of privacy. The expansive grounds offer ample outdoor space for families, gardening enthusiasts, or those seeking a peaceful rural setting. A substantial block-built shed measuring approximately 7m x 4.5m provides excellent storage or workshop potential and benefits from electricity.
Despite its peaceful setting, the property remains highly accessible, located just 10km from Arklow, approximately 4km from Coolgreany, 7km from Kilanerin, and 15km from Gorey. This is an ideal opportunity to acquire a spacious family home in a scenic rural location while remaining close to a wide range of amenities.
